items.headline: Brennan leads Baycurrent Classic
items.text: Michael Brennan leads the Baycurrent Classic in Japan with a 16-under total, finishing one shot ahead of Keith Mitchell and Jacob Bridgeman at 15-under.

items.headline: McIlroy Praised by DP World Tour
items.text: Rory McIlroy received high praise from the DP World Tour chief, emphasizing meritocracy as the path for players to return to top-level golf.

items.headline: McIlroy Opens Door for LIV Players
items.text: Rory McIlroy’s meritocracy stance has created a clear path for former LIV Golf players to rejoin elite professional golf.
